Building the islet…

The islet is 110 µm across. Drag to turn, scroll to zoom.

A representative human islet

An islet of Langerhans of mean human size, built from published measurements. It is a model, not an imaged islet.

Simulated: built from published measurements

    How it was built

    Cells are packed as solid tissue in a sphere 110 µm across. Capillaries are threaded through until 95% of cells lie within one and a half cell diameters of one. Cell types are assigned in the proportions below. No clustering was needed: types assigned at random already give the share of beta cells touching another type that Cabrera et al. measured, so the model keeps them random.
